name: Secret guard
description: Catches API keys, tokens, private keys and passwords in a message before it reaches the agent.
author: Mango

settings.label: When a message holds a secret
settings.description: Ask lets you send it anyway. Mask replaces each secret with a placeholder and sends the rest. Block never sends it.

settings.label: Catch password= and token= assignments
settings.description: Also flags values written after password, secret, token or api_key. Turn it off if it fires on example code too often.
